<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="IEUCJ6CBqFHTVZJpmTTM"> <mxGraphModel dx="2575" dy="1405" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml
title AI Query Processing Architecture

skinparam backgroundColor white
skinparam componentStyle rectangle
skinparam shadowing false

rectangle \"Input Layer\" as input {
 rectangle \"User Query / LLM Response\" as A
}

rectangle \"Orchestration Layer\" as orchestration {
 rectangle \"Orchestrator (LangGraph)\" as B
 rectangle \"Planner / Task Decomposition\" as C
}

rectangle \"Knowledge Layer\" as knowledge {
 rectangle \"RAG / Retrieval Engine\" as D
 database \"Vector DB (Qdrant)\" as D1
 database \"Knowledge Graph (Neo4j)\" as D2
}

rectangle \"Verification Layer\" as verification {
 rectangle \"Fact Verification Agent\" as E1
 rectangle \"Citation Verification Agent\" as E2
 rectangle \"Contradiction / Logic Agent\" as E3
}

rectangle \"Assessment Layer\" as assessment {
 rectangle \"Reliability / Evaluator Agent\" as F
 database \"Memory / Audit Storage (PostgreSQL)\" as G
}

rectangle \"Refinement Layer\" as refinement {
 rectangle \"Response Refinement / Self-Repair Agent\" as H
 rectangle \"Response Generator\" as I
 rectangle \"Final Output\" as J
}

A --> B
B --> C
C --> D

D --> D1
D --> D2

D --> E1
D --> E2
D --> E3

E1 --> F
E2 --> F
E3 --> F

F --> G
F --> H
F --> I

H --> B
I --> J

@enduml",
 "config": null
